import bisect

def main():
    n = int(input())
    ts = list(map(int, input().split()))
    T = int(input())
    
    ts.sort()
    
    maxCount = 1
    for i in range(n):
        upperBound = ts[i] + T
        upperIdx = bisect.bisect_right(ts, upperBound)
        maxCount = max(maxCount, upperIdx - i)
    
    print(maxCount)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
